branches.limitations: Conditional on pcall returning and the shared buffer, instruction arrays, constant caches, and boolean lookup table remaining unchanged. The writers and closure 727 retain their source-derived identities, and unrelated frame registers are unchanged. The 830, 5395, and 7621 constant caches are assumed empty. The pc 830/5395 calls assume the writer closure 720 returns and affects captured registers 120/121 only.  The closure 436 return value is unknown; nested continuations separately assume its truthiness. The pc 1163 constant cache is assumed initially empty. At pc 1164, the conditional summary of closure 727 writes captures 120/121. Captured registers and the second pcall result are unknown; closing upvalues at 221/742 is assumed to preserve frame registers.
